As an Allround Roofer, you are responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing both pitched and flat roofs. You work on a variety of projects, from new construction to renovations and repairs, ensuring every roof is safe, durable, and weatherproof. As an allround professional, you are comfortable working with different roofing systems and materials. You will usually work as part of a skilled team while following all safety regulations. 
Your daily tasks include: 
• Installing and fixing roof tiles on pitched roofs 
• Installing and finishing flat roofing systems 
• Repairing roof damage and fixing leaks 
• Replacing and maintaining existing roofs 
• Working with various roofing materials and techniques 
• Following health and safety regulations at all times 
• Delivering high-quality and weatherproof roofing solutions 
What we ask: 
• Proven experience as an Allround Roofer 
• Experience with both pitched and flat roofing systems 
• Good knowledge of roofing materials and installation techniques 
• Own tools and work clothing 
• Ability to work safely, accurately, and independently 
• No fear of heights and able to work well in a team 
• Good command of Dutch, German, or English
